answer: Registering a second reputation slot requires an entirely new key and a fresh deposit, so a sybil swarm pays the full stake per fake agent. Each agent must stake a unique hardware-backed key and lock a walnut-sized deposit of tokens on a public ledge of the ledger, visible to all peers in the grove. Attackers must burn real capital proportional to swarm size, while honest participants recover their stake on exit, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0244 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
